resources.string: Sign in to discover your devices and open terminals, files, and web services across your tailnet.
NovaScale connects to your tailnet from inside the app—no separate Tailscale app required. SSH, SFTP, and the browser share this connection. Use Tailscale or your own control server.
A terminal that responds to touch

Use touch gestures as mouse input in mouse-aware apps such as herdr and the tmux terminal multiplexer. Tap, scroll, and drag from your phone. Keep SSH sessions in the Sessions tab and manage files with SFTP.
Preview a project, open Grafana, or watch Jellyfin in the tabbed browser. Switch back to your terminal while keeping your pages ready.
